from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
from green.infrastructure.cad.documents import load_document
from ezdxf.lldxf.tagwriter import TagCollector
import json
for p in sorted(Path("out/real-input-survey").rglob("*.dxf")):
    doc, warnings = load_document(p)
    regions = list(doc.modelspace().query("REGION"))
    result = {
        "file": p.name,
        "version": doc.dxfversion,
        "regions": len(regions),
        "region_layers": Counter(e.dxf.layer for e in regions),
        "region_payload_lengths": Counter((len(e.sat), len(e.sab)) for e in regions),
        "region_exportable": sum(e.preprocess_export(TagCollector(dxfversion=doc.dxfversion)) for e in regions),
        "xrefs": [],
    }
    result["region_payload_lengths"] = {str(k): v for k,v in result["region_payload_lengths"].items()}
    for e in doc.modelspace().query("INSERT"):
        b = doc.blocks.get(e.dxf.name)
        if b is not None and (b.block.is_xref or b.block.is_xref_overlay):
            result["xrefs"].append({"name": e.dxf.name, "file": b.block.dxf.xref_path, "scale": [e.dxf.xscale,e.dxf.yscale,e.dxf.zscale], "rotation": e.dxf.rotation, "offset": tuple(e.dxf.insert), "base": tuple(b.block.dxf.base_point)})
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import json, subprocess, time
from green.infrastructure.cad.documents import load_document
from ezdxf.acis import api as acis
source = next(Path("../").glob("Пилотны*/6. Камчатская улица/Исходные данные/Внешние ссылки/игди/XREF_ИГДИ_Камчатская улица.dwg"))
out = Path("out/acis-conversion")
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
for version in ("r2000", "r2010"):
    target = out / (version + ".dxf")
    started = time.perf_counter()
    done = subprocess.run(["dwg2dxf", "-y", "--as", version, "-o", str(target), str(source)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=90)
    (out / (version + ".conversion.log")).write_text(done.stdout + done.stderr)
    result = {"version": version, "returncode": done.returncode, "bytes": target.stat().st_size if target.exists() else 0}
    try:
        doc, notes = load_document(target)
        regions = list(doc.modelspace().query("REGION"))
        result.update(regions=len(regions), with_payload=sum(bool(e.acis_data) for e in regions), notes=notes)
        if regions and regions[0].acis_data:
            bodies = acis.load_dxf(regions[0])
            result["first_body_meshes"] = [len(mesh.faces) for body in bodies for mesh in acis.mesh_from_body(body)]
    except Exception as error:
        result["load_error"] = str(error)
    result["seconds"] = round(time.perf_counter() - started, 3)
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))
